select source_row_number
from "retail"."ods"."retail_raw"
where source_row_number is null

select
    source_row_number as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "retail"."ods"."retail_raw"
where source_row_number is not null
group by source_row_number
having count(*) > 1

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT source_row_number,
           NULLIF(TRIM(invoice_no), '') AS invoice_no,
           NULLIF(TRIM(stock_code), '') AS stock_code,
           NULLIF(TRIM(description), '') AS description,
           CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(20,4)) = TRUNC(TRY_CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(20,4)))
                THEN TRY_CAST(quantity AS BIGINT) END AS quantity,
           TRY_CAST(invoice_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS invoice_ts,
           TRY_CAST(unit_price AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS unit_price,
           NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '') AS customer_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(country), ''), '未知国家') AS country,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY invoice_no, stock_code, description, quantity,
                            invoice_date, unit_price, customer_id, country
               ORDER BY source_row_number
           ) > 1 AS is_exact_duplicate
    FROM "retail"."ods"."retail_raw"
), classified AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(UPPER(invoice_no) LIKE 'C%', FALSE) AS is_cancelled
    FROM normalized
)
SELECT source_row_number, invoice_no, stock_code, description, quantity, invoice_ts,
       unit_price, customer_id, country, is_cancelled,
       COALESCE(invoice_no IS NOT NULL AND stock_code IS NOT NULL
                AND invoice_ts IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 AND unit_price > 0
                AND NOT is_cancelled, FALSE) AS is_positive_sale,
       is_exact_duplicate
FROM classified
ORDER BY source_row_number

WITH countries AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT country FROM "retail"."stg"."clean_transactions" WHERE country <> '未知国家'
), keyed AS (SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY country) AS country_key,country FROM countries
 UNION ALL SELECT 0,'未知国家')
SELECT *,country='United Kingdom' AS is_home_market,
 CASE WHEN country='未知国家' THEN '未知' WHEN country='United Kingdom' THEN '本土' ELSE '海外' END AS market_type
FROM keyed

WITH stats AS (
 SELECT customer_id,min(invoice_ts::DATE) AS first_transaction_date,
 max(invoice_ts::DATE) AS last_transaction_date,
 min(invoice_ts::DATE) FILTER(WHERE is_positive_sale) AS first_purchase_date,
 max(invoice_ts::DATE) FILTER(WHERE is_positive_sale) AS last_purchase_date,
 count(DISTINCT country) AS observed_country_count
 FROM "retail"."stg"."clean_transactions" WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY customer_id) AS customer_key,*,false AS is_unknown FROM stats
UNION ALL SELECT 0,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,0,true

WITH calendar AS (
 SELECT calendar_date::DATE AS full_date FROM generate_series(
 (SELECT min(invoice_ts::DATE) FROM "retail"."stg"."clean_transactions"),
 (SELECT max(invoice_ts::DATE) FROM "retail"."stg"."clean_transactions"),INTERVAL 1 DAY) t(calendar_date)
), dates AS (SELECT NULL::DATE AS full_date UNION ALL SELECT full_date FROM calendar)
SELECT coalesce(strftime(full_date,'%Y%m%d')::INTEGER,0) AS date_key,full_date,
 year(full_date)::INTEGER AS year, quarter(full_date)::INTEGER AS quarter,
 month(full_date)::INTEGER AS month, day(full_date)::INTEGER AS day,
 isodow(full_date)::INTEGER AS iso_weekday, week(full_date)::INTEGER AS iso_week,
 strftime(full_date,'%G')::INTEGER AS iso_year,
 dayname(full_date) AS weekday_name, isodow(full_date) IN (6,7) AS is_weekend,
 date_trunc('month',full_date)::DATE AS month_start,last_day(full_date) AS month_end,
 strftime(full_date,'%Y-%m') AS year_month
FROM dates

WITH known AS (WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT trim(stock_code) AS stock_code,
           nullif(trim(description), '') AS description,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY trim(stock_code)
               ORDER BY (nullif(trim(description), '') IS NOT NULL) DESC,
                        invoice_ts DESC NULLS LAST,
                        source_row_number DESC
           ) AS description_rank
    FROM "retail"."stg"."clean_transactions"
    WHERE nullif(trim(stock_code), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY stock_code) AS product_key,
       stock_code,
       coalesce(description, '商品名称缺失') AS description
FROM candidates
WHERE description_rank = 1) SELECT * FROM known UNION ALL SELECT 0,NULL,'未知商品'

SELECT t.source_row_number,
       t.invoice_no,
       t.invoice_ts,
       coalesce(d.date_key, 0) AS date_key,
       coalesce(p.product_key, 0) AS product_key,
       coalesce(c.customer_key, 0) AS customer_key,
       coalesce(g.country_key, 0) AS country_key,
       t.quantity,
       t.unit_price,
       CAST(CAST(t.quantity AS DECIMAL(18,0)) * t.unit_price AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS line_amount,
       coalesce(t.is_cancelled, false) AS is_cancelled,
       coalesce(t.is_positive_sale, false) AS is_positive_sale,
       coalesce(t.is_exact_duplicate, false) AS is_exact_duplicate
FROM "retail"."stg"."clean_transactions" AS t
LEFT JOIN "retail"."dim"."date" AS d ON CAST(t.invoice_ts AS DATE) = d.full_date
LEFT JOIN "retail"."dim"."product" AS p ON nullif(trim(t.stock_code), '') = p.stock_code
LEFT JOIN "retail"."dim"."customer" AS c ON nullif(trim(t.customer_id), '') = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN "retail"."dim"."country" AS g
    ON coalesce(nullif(trim(t.country), ''), '未知国家') = g.country

WITH amounts AS (
 SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "retail"."dwd"."fact_transaction") AS facts,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM "retail"."ods"."retail_raw") AS raw,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(quantity*unit_price),0) FROM "retail"."stg"."clean_transactions" WHERE is_positive_sale) AS expected_sales,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(line_amount),0) FROM "retail"."dwd"."fact_sales") AS actual_sales,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(sales_amount),0) FROM "retail"."dws"."sales_day_country") AS daily_sales,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(sales_amount),0) FROM "retail"."dws"."product_day_country") AS product_sales,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(line_amount),0) FROM "retail"."dwd"."fact_sales" WHERE customer_key<>0) AS known_sales,
 (SELECT coalesce(sum(sales_amount),0) FROM "retail"."dws"."customer_day_country") AS customer_sales
) SELECT * FROM amounts WHERE facts<>raw OR expected_sales<>actual_sales OR actual_sales<>daily_sales OR actual_sales<>product_sales OR known_sales<>customer_sales

WITH totals AS (
 SELECT sales_amount,cancellation_amount,net_recorded_amount,order_count,customer_count FROM "retail"."ads"."overview"
), results AS (
 SELECT 'cube' AS source,sales_amount,cancellation_amount,net_recorded_amount,order_count,customer_count FROM "retail"."ads"."transaction_cube" WHERE grouping_id=7
 UNION ALL SELECT 'rollup',sales_amount,cancellation_amount,net_recorded_amount,order_count,customer_count FROM "retail"."ads"."time_rollup" WHERE grouping_id=7
) SELECT r.* FROM results r CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE r.sales_amount<>t.sales_amount OR r.cancellation_amount<>t.cancellation_amount
 OR r.net_recorded_amount<>t.net_recorded_amount OR r.order_count<>t.order_count OR r.customer_count<>t.customer_count
 UNION ALL SELECT 'net',sales_amount,cancellation_amount,net_recorded_amount,order_count,customer_count FROM totals WHERE net_recorded_amount<>sales_amount-cancellation_amount
